regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is narrow (4 of 17 themes trend-eligible) and non-directional, with Banks (H + HK) holding the rank-1 focus spot on high durability (0.67) but almost no rotation breadth. The absolute-trend gate has helped historically (validated risk control), so eligible themes deserve trend respect, but there is no predictive edge to extract from the ranks themselves.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the rotation breadth broadens: currently only 4 of 17 themes are trend-eligible (frac 0.24, view narrow), so leadership is thin. A confirmed handoff from Banks to a second eligible theme would require the challenger Energy to sustain an equal-weight margin over Banks for 10 consecutive sessions while breadth_of_rotation frac rises above 0.4.
